// @action: refactor Inline variable/Inline variable
// @differs: tsserver writes `touch()` then `[n].push(1)`, which reads as `touch()[n].push(1)`; ours declines
// @file: src/main.ts
declare function touch(): void
export function f(n: number) {
  const /*|*/list = [n]
  touch()
  list.push(1)
  return list
}
